name: Anvil Player Heads
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: crimulus
description: Adds the ability to rename a minecraft:player_head in an anvil and update it to the corresponding player's skin. Requires a way to acquire the player_head object. I use a custom recipe to craft zombie_head → player_head.
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3), Machines (0.4), Mixin (0.5)
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
